properties.description: Built 2026-10-23, PR A2. independence_of compares, besides steps and cited results, every node neither line derives: a proposition taken as given, a claim nobody showed, an assumption nothing discharges — `shared_premises`, making the statement false unless independent_except names it (a premise beneath a named lemma is the lemma's). Definitions, axioms and method rules, and premises both final steps take up directly (the theorem's own setting), are named in `shared_setting` and leave the lines independent; a discharged supposition is never shared. add_inference now removes a key an empty list clears (upsert_node merged, so `independent_of: []` left the old value). Measured: Gettier case 2 vs case 1 holds→false naming req:g-closure, req:g-fallibility; NS Lean vs natural-language routes holds→false naming req:claim-lean-check-passes; four colour Coq vs RSST names con:rsst-633-configurations in shared_setting (a definition) and reads false once recorded as a proposition; heat, Arrow and logic readings unchanged.
properties.name: Two lines stated independent are checked against every premise both rest on, naming it (shared_premises), with the vocabulary and the theorem's own setting named apart (shared_setting); independent_of: [] clears the statement
